subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should the repository accept all 13 new action revisions together once the final rebased head passes the relevant credential, release, CodeQL, and Codex workflow checks?
rationale: These revisions execute third-party code inside privileged automation, so green generic CI cannot substitute for repository-owner acceptance of the supply-chain and operational boundary.

options.title: Approve the verified batch
options.body: Approve the grouped immutable revisions after the final rebased SHA completes the relevant security and release workflow checks.

options.title: Split sensitive action families
options.body: Separate Codex, Docker publishing, app-token, and CodeQL updates so each privileged workflow family can be validated and landed independently.

options.title: Hold the current pins
options.body: Keep the existing revisions until upstream provenance or exact-head workflow behavior is sufficiently clear.

recommendation.title: Approve the verified batch
recommendation.body: Approve the grouped immutable revisions after the final rebased SHA completes the relevant security and release workflow checks.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows direct ownership of the affected Docker release and validation workflows, alongside documented repository leadership.
